Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 83. Category: form. God Forms.

Godly Power-Up
A Namekian that has obtained god ki can take an
enhanced state with red eyes and a fiery aura.
Increase your Power by 3
You deal an additional 1d12 to all damage
Increase your Movement Speed by 30 ft.
You gain an additional +2 to your AC.
At the end of your turn, you lose 3 Stamina
